children.text: If you're a property owner, you know that managing your utilities can be a real headache. From monitoring usage to billing tenants, it can be a time-consuming and frustrating process. That's where submetering electricity comes in. By installing individual meters to measure the consumption of electricity for each tenant in a building or complex, submetering promotes fairness and transparency, and can incentivize tenants to reduce their energy usage.

At Axis Meter Solutions, we're specialists in sub-metering for a diverse range of real estate investments. Our submetering solutions provide accurate and reliable data to help you manage your utilities more efficiently. With our submetering services, you'll be able to track actual energy usage and bill tenants based on their individual consumption, which can lead to lower operating costs and higher property values.

Our submetering solutions are also 100% regulatory compliant, so you can rest assured that you're following all the necessary guidelines and regulations. With our expertise and experience, we can help you improve your energy efficiency and streamline your utility management. Whether you're a property owner or a tenant, submetering electricity is a smart and effective way to manage your utilities. And with Axis Meter Solutions, you can be confident that you're getting the best submetering services available.
Understanding Submetering

If you're looking for ways to better manage your energy consumption and reduce your electricity bills, submetering could be the solution you need. In this section, we'll explain what submetering is, the different types of submeters available, and the benefits of using submetering for electricity.
What Is Submetering?

Submetering is the installation of additional meters within a building to measure the electricity consumed by individual units or departments. This allows building owners or property managers to accurately measure energy consumption and bill tenants based on their actual usage. With submetering, you can identify and better comprehend your consumption habits, and promote fairness and transparency in billing.
Types of Submeters
There are several types of submeters available, including electrical submeters, gas submeters, and water submeters. Learn more about
electricity submetering
. Learn more about
water submetering solutions

. Electrical submeters are the most common type of submeter and are used to measure the electricity consumed by individual units or departments. Gas submeters are used to measure the gas consumed by individual units or departments, while water submeters are used to measure the water consumed by individual units or departments.
Benefits of Electricity Submetering
Electricity submetering has several benefits, including:
Cost savings:
Submetering allows you to identify areas of high energy consumption and take steps to reduce them, resulting in lower electricity bills.
Energy conservation:
Submetering helps you to identify areas where energy is being wasted and take steps to improve energy efficiency.
Transparency:
Submetering promotes transparency in billing, as tenants are billed based on their actual usage.
Regulatory compliance:
Submetering helps you to comply with regulatory requirements related to energy consumption and billing.

At Axis Meter Solutions, we're specialists in submetering for a diverse range of real estate investments. Our submetering solutions can help you to achieve a 32% average property value increase and an 18% reduction in operating costs. We're also 100% regulatory compliant, so you can be confident that you're meeting all legal requirements related to energy consumption and billing.
The Role of Submetering in Energy Management

If you're looking to optimize your energy management, submetering is an essential tool to consider. Submetering allows you to monitor energy consumption on a more granular level, which can help you identify areas where energy is being wasted and promote energy-efficient practices. In this section, we'll explore some of the key ways that submetering can help you better manage your energy usage.
Monitoring Energy Consumption

One of the primary benefits of submetering is that it allows you to monitor energy consumption in real-time. By installing submeters throughout your property, you can track energy usage by specific areas, tenants, or equipment. This data can help you identify areas where energy is being wasted, which can lead to significant cost savings over time.
Promoting Energy-Efficient Practices

In addition to helping you identify areas where energy is being wasted, submetering can also help you promote energy-efficient practices. By providing tenants with real-time data on their energy usage, you can encourage them to be more mindful of their energy consumption. This can lead to a more sustainable and cost-effective property over time.
Real-Time Data and Energy Management

Real-time data is a critical component of effective energy management. With submetering, you can access real-time data on energy usage, which can help you make informed decisions about your energy consumption. This can include adjusting your energy usage during peak hours or identifying equipment that is using more energy than necessary.

If you're looking for a submetering solution for your property, Axis Meter Solutions is the best option for Utility Management. As specialists in sub-metering for a diverse range of real estate investments, we offer a range of metrics to help you optimize your energy management. Our metrics include a 32% average property value increase, 18% lower operating costs, and 100% regulatory compliance.
Installation and Maintenance of Submetering Systems

Submetering systems are an essential component of utility management in real estate investments. The installation process of submetering systems requires a high level of expertise and attention to detail. After installation, regular maintenance ensures that the system remains fully functional and compliant with regulations.
Submetering System Installation Process

The installation process of submetering systems involves several steps. First, the site must be surveyed to determine the most suitable locations for the installation of submeters. Next, the submeters are installed, and the wiring is connected to the electrical panel. Once the installation is complete, the submeters are tested to ensure that they are accurately measuring the energy consumption of each tenant.

It is important to work with a reputable submetering company such as Axis Meter Solutions to ensure that the installation process is carried out by experienced professionals. Axis Meter Solutions is a specialist in sub-metering for a diverse range of real estate investments, and their metrics include a 32% average property value increase and 18% lower operating costs.
Maintenance and Compliance

Regular maintenance is essential to ensure that submetering systems continue to function optimally. Maintenance activities include cleaning, calibration, and testing of the submeters. It is important to ensure that the submeters are compliant with regulatory requirements, such as the National Electrical Code (NEC) and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

Axis Meter Solutions is 100% regulatory compliant, and they provide regular maintenance services to ensure that submetering systems remain fully functional and compliant with regulations. Working with a reputable submetering company such as Axis Meter Solutions ensures that you have access to the best practices in submetering system installation and maintenance.
Billing and Fairness

Submetering electricity is an essential process that enables accurate billing and usage tracking. When it comes to billing, it is crucial to ensure that the charges are accurate and reflect the actual energy consumed. This is where submetering comes in. By installing submeters for each tenant or unit, the utility bill can be accurately allocated based on actual usage. This accuracy eliminates the need for landlords to estimate the energy consumed by each tenant, which can lead to overbilling or underbilling.
Accurate Billing and Usage

Submetering electricity ensures accurate billing and usage tracking. With submeters, tenants can monitor their energy consumption and make necessary adjustments to reduce their usage and lower their utility bills. In addition, submetering allows landlords to bill tenants for their actual energy consumption, eliminating the need for flat-rate billing or estimates.

As a result, submetering leads to more efficient energy usage and cost savings for both tenants and landlords. With accurate billing, tenants are more likely to pay their utility bills on time, which can improve the overall financial health of the property.
Ensuring Fairness for Tenants and Owners

Submetering also ensures fairness for both tenants and owners. With submeters, tenants are only charged for the energy they consume, which promotes fairness and transparency. This eliminates the possibility of overcharging or undercharging, which can lead to disputes between tenants and landlords.

Moreover, submetering allows landlords to allocate energy costs based on usage, which promotes fairness among tenants. This approach ensures that tenants who consume more energy pay more, while those who consume less pay less.

Axis Meter Solutions is a leading provider of submetering services, specializing in utility management for a diverse range of real estate investments. With a 32% average property value increase and 18% lower operating costs, our submetering solutions are designed to save you money while promoting fairness and transparency. Our solutions are 100% regulatory compliant, ensuring that you are always in compliance with local regulations.
Legal and Regulatory Considerations

When it comes to submetering electricity, there are several legal and regulatory considerations that you need to take into account. In this section, we will discuss the compliance with jurisdictions and public service commission regulations.
Compliance with Jurisdictions

It is important to ensure that your submetering practices comply with the relevant jurisdictions. Different states have different laws and regulations regarding submetering. For example, in New York, submetering is legal, but there are specific requirements that must be met, such as obtaining approval from the Public Service Commission (PSC) and providing tenants with a written notice of submetering.

At Axis Meter Solutions, we are experts in submetering for a diverse range of real estate investments. We ensure that our submetering practices comply with all relevant jurisdictions. Our team of specialists stays up-to-date with all regulatory changes to ensure that our clients are always in compliance.
Public Service Commission Regulations

In addition to complying with relevant jurisdictions, it is important to comply with the regulations set by the Public Service Commission (PSC). The PSC regulates submetering practices in New York and other states. PSC regulations include requirements for meter accuracy, billing practices, and customer service.

At Axis Meter Solutions, we ensure that our submetering practices comply with all PSC regulations. We use state-of-the-art equipment to ensure meter accuracy, and we provide transparent billing practices and exceptional customer service. Our metrics speak for themselves, with an average property value increase of 32% and lower operating costs of 18%. Additionally, we are proud to say that we are 100% regulatory compliant.

In summary, compliance with jurisdictions and PSC regulations is crucial when it comes to submetering electricity. At Axis Meter Solutions, we are confident in our ability to provide the best utility management services for our clients.
